title: statutory-offences-of-causing-death-by-driving-sentencing-guideline.pdf — section 23
text:
RECORD AND

CIRCUMSTANCES

OF DRIVER
Relevant previous convictions (not
necessarily limited to convictions for
road traffic offences)
Deceased was family member or close
friend of driver
Remorse
Voluntary surrender of licence (where
applicable)

CIRCUMSTANCES

OF OFFENCE AND

ACTIONS AT THE
SCENE
Other offences committed at the same
time (for example, leaving the scene
of the offence with a view to evading
detection)
Victim was a vulnerable road user (for
example, a pedestrian, cyclist, horse
rider, or motorcyclist)
Providing assistance at the scene
Genuine belief on the part of the driver
that they were not, as the case may be,
uninsured/unlicensed/disqualified from
driving
The actions of the victim or someone
else contributed to the commission of
the offence
Driving in an emergency, whether in
a designated emergency vehicle or
otherwise
Step 3: Identify aggravating and mitigating factors
